name: Elite Express Holding Inc. Class A Common Stock
summary: Operating across California, Elite Express Holding Inc. specializes in comprehensive final-mile logistics, seamlessly connecting businesses with their end-customers. Their services encompass the complete parcel journey, from initial collection and transit to ultimate delivery, further complemented by mechanisms for post-delivery feedback. These operations are efficiently executed using their fleet of trucks and trailers. Established in 2020, the company's headquarters are located in Laguna Hills, California.
